subject.title: fix(fal): apply request policy to media generation requests

question: Does the controlled local FAL-compatible server proof satisfy the merge gate for forwarding configured proxy, TLS, authentication, and private-network policy, or is representative live transport proof required?
rationale: The code follows the established provider request-policy contract, but repository policy requires live verification for external API behavior and the submitted evidence does not exercise the changed external transport boundary.

options.title: Require Live Transport Proof
options.body: Ask for redacted current-head proof through a real FAL request or representative proxy/private endpoint before merge.

options.title: Accept Controlled Proof
options.body: A provider owner may explicitly accept the localhost provider-path transcript plus shared resolver coverage as sufficient for this narrow forwarding change.

recommendation.title: Require Live Transport Proof
recommendation.body: Ask for redacted current-head proof through a real FAL request or representative proxy/private endpoint before merge.

likelyOwner.reason: They introduced the shared FAL HTTP helper and subsequent generated-media network hardening most directly affected by this decision.
